answer: To improve your ability to remember people's names, try these techniques: Actively listen when someone introduces themselves and focus on their name. Repeating the name aloud in your mind shortly after first hearing it can help your brain process it. Creating a strong image or association with the name, such as visualizing the person's name with their appearance, can also enhance memory retention. Regular practice and feedback, such as asking them their name repeatedly, can reinforce the memory.
